gates.notes: Immutable upstream revision is now pinned to 9d2b6ace3e23199e2a896de329d4c16489b09a96. The top-level README identifies FUNIT/ and base/modules/modules.py as third-party exceptions; dependency-closure license audit and reproducible baseline execution remain incomplete, so this gate remains BLOCKED.
Candidate sources are documented, but every asset intended for training still needs an individual license and training-permission decision.

GitHub Actions downloaded and audited the actual published font and glyph release archives. Result: 7,904 samples, 52 font files, 20 families, family splits train=14/validation=3/test=3, all 7,904 referenced images verified, zero audit errors. The prior duplicate warning was a false positive caused by the audit tool reading target_index instead of target_index_logical; fixed and covered by a regression test.
Existing samples are contextual full-line renders with logical target indices, not audited isolated target-glyph crops with verified HarfBuzz cluster mapping.
Schemas and templates exist, but a populated, provenance-reviewed paired prompt/measurement dataset has not been demonstrated.
The unified architecture is specified, but executable image encoder, prompt encoder, shared latent alignment, shared generator, and hybrid path have not been verified in this repository.
Required unit tests, forward/backward smoke tests, tiny-subset overfit, checkpoint round-trip, and resume tests have not been evidenced.
The local Windows preflight must be run on the actual machine; current GPU, VRAM, RAM, disk, backend compatibility, and runtime estimates are not established here.

Intermediate adapter code is committed. GitHub Actions successfully compiled both scripts and passed four deterministic episode-sampler unit tests. The crop builder has not been run against the user's local font archive; this PASS covers code compilation and sampler tests only.

Unicode 17.0 joining metadata registry structure validates; CI passed. Scope is basic Arabic alphabet plus two common extensions. Visual-family/dot metadata is explicitly provisional and does not constitute audited MX-Font component/decomposition labels.

CI generated and validated 1,413 assigned Script=Arabic records from pinned Unicode 17.0 UCD files with source hashes. This is script-level metadata, not a language-specific gold corpus or visual decomposition dataset.
Schema and validator implemented; this does not mean any glyphs have been annotated or independently reviewed.
Regression inputs and HarfBuzz capture runner exist, but no run against a legally cleared font has been performed yet.
Per-component polygon agreement analyzer and unit tests passed. This validates the comparison tool, not actual human agreement; no real double-annotated pilot has yet been created.

Per-file rights manifest schema, fail-closed validator, and batch HarfBuzz runner are implemented. The batch runner requires at least three distinct approved font families and exact SHA-256 matches. CI compiled the tools and passed 25 unit tests. The template is intentionally empty; no font-specific ML-training permissions have been reviewed or approved yet.

Fail-closed audit tool and tests are implemented. GitHub Actions run 44476157196 downloaded the published release archives and audited the actual published corpus successfully; all 30 repository unit tests passed.

CI built 1,736 HarfBuzz cluster crops from 52 font files/20 families across 10 shaping cases; independently reproduced all 1,736 glyph-ID mappings over 520 font-case pairs, checked logical source spans and explicit non-rendering controls/separators, verified image readability and provenance, and reported 238 multi-codepoint clusters with zero errors. This is integrity/shaping consistency, not human visual or linguistic validation.

A stratified review-pack builder and review rubric are now implemented, but creating a package is not a review result. Two qualified human reviewers must independently inspect the visual/linguistic sample, compare independent renderings, and adjudicate every failure/uncertainty. This gate remains BLOCKED.

A 40-item (target) geometry pilot is prepared from single-codepoint/single-glyph clusters with separate blank templates for two independent annotators and an adjudication tracker. No human annotations or adjudications have been submitted yet; this gate remains BLOCKED.

CI successfully generated and uploaded arabic-human-review-pack. Verified artifact: 100 visual/linguistic samples (10 per each of 10 shaping cases, 10 font families represented per case) and 40 geometry pilot samples drawn from the full eligible corpus, balanced over eight eligible cases. Separate 40-record draft ledgers for annotators A/B and adjudication tracker were included. This PASS certifies package generation and tests only; no human review or label approval has occurred.

Create two independent component annotations per selected glyph instance, compute per-kind agreement, adjudicate disagreements, and promote only adjudicated labels.
Populate exact per-file font rights records with authoritative license evidence and ML-training permission; keep all unapproved font-derived data excluded from training.
Complete the generated visual/linguistic review pack with two independent human reviews and adjudicate every fail/uncertain item.
Complete the independent two-annotator geometry pilot, compute per-class agreement, and adjudicate disagreements; do not train on draft annotations.
recommended_next_step: Complete exact per-file font rights approvals, then run batch HarfBuzz across at least three distinct approved families. Generate and visually inspect target crops and build a two-annotator pilot. Other model, paired-data, hardware, and checkpoint gates remain blocked.
